This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

```bash
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. - `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	# SampleScratch：一次分配的缓冲区布局与 selection_width
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	- 逐字段说出 `SampleScratch` 里每个缓冲区的角色：`row_indices`、`argmax_partial_values` / `argmax_partial_indices`、`top1_values`、`argmax_out`、`argmax_host` / `argmax_host_alt`、`identity_rows`，以及内嵌的 `BatchSamplingScratch`。
8	- 解释解码路径为什么要求**一次分配、指针稳定**——绝不能每个解码步重新分配设备缓冲。
9	- 用定长公式 \( R \times \lceil V / 4096 \rceil \) 算出 argmax partials 缓冲的元素个数，并说明它来自两阶段（split）argmax 的 tiling 结构。
10	- 说清 `vocab`（arena 物理宽度）与 `selection_width`（可发射词表宽度）为什么是两个数：模型把 logits GEMM 对齐到 tile 倍数后，多出来的填充列不是可发射 token，不能参与 u2-l1 讲的 `top_p <= 1/宽度` 核坍缩判定（#1046 场景）。
11	- 论证贪心行与非贪心行的缓冲为什么互不相交、可以共用同一份 scratch 服务一个混合批。
12	
13	本讲是单元二的第二讲：u2-l1 已经确定了「一行走不走 argmax」的判定条件，本讲看这个判定的**物质基础**——判定所依赖的 `selection_width`、判定结果所写入的全部缓冲，都住在这份一次分配的 `SampleScratch` 里。下一讲 u2-l3 会沿着这些缓冲走通 `select_batch` 的三路分发。
14	
15	## 2. 前置知识
16	
17	本讲需要一点 GPU 内存模型的常识，全部概念先用直觉语言讲一遍。
18	
19	- **解码步（decode step）**：自回归生成是循环的——每一步模型为批内每个活跃请求算出一行 logits（全词表各一个分数），采样层从每行选出一个 token id，再把 token 喂回模型。采样层因此被调用成千上万次，每次的输入输出形状几乎完全一样。
20	- **设备内存与主机内存**：GPU 自己的显存（device memory）与 CPU 内存（host memory）是两块独立空间，靠 H2D（host-to-device，上行）与 D2H（device-to-host，下行）拷贝交换数据。`CudaSlice<T>` 是一块显存的 Rust 句柄。
21	- **分配很贵，拷贝也不免费**：`cudaMalloc` 量级的显存分配是慢操作（可能牵动驱动同步），H2D / D2H 拷贝则要走 PCIe。推理引擎的常规做法是**启动时按最大形状分配一次，之后每步只写入数据、不重新分配**。
22	- **指针稳定（pointer stability）**：CUDA 图（CUDA Graph）会把一整段核调用录制下来重放，录制时烘焙的是**缓冲的地址**。如果某一步换了缓冲（重新分配），地址变了，图里录的旧地址就指向已释放或错误的内存。所以「解码路径的缓冲绝不能每步重分配」不是性能建议，是正确性约束（u4-l1 展开）。
23	- **pinned 内存（页锁定内存）**：普通主机内存是可换页的，从它做 D2H 拷贝时驱动会先把它钉住再拷，语义偏同步；用 `alloc_pinned` 预先锁定的页则支持真正的异步 D2H。本讲只需要记住：`SampleScratch` 的两个主机落地区是 pinned 的，事故级的细节（#704）留给 u4-l2。
24	- **两阶段（split / tiled）argmax 的直觉**：一行 15 万个 bf16 的 argmax 如果只用一个 GPU 线程块（CTA）扫，太慢。把一行切成若干 4096 元素的 tile，每个 tile 由一个 CTA 求出局部的 (最大值, 下标)——这就是 **partial**；第二阶段每行用一个 CTA 把所有 partial 归约成全局 argmax。partial 的个数决定了缓冲长度。
25	- **tile 对齐与填充列**：GEMM（矩阵乘）在 tile 倍数宽度上效率最高，模型可能把 logits 输出宽度从真实词表 \( V \)（如 151936）垫宽到 tile 的倍数。垫出来的列**不是可发射 token**——采样决策不能把它们数进词表宽度。
26	- **承接 u2-l1**：`effectively_greedy(params, vocab_size)` 在 `top_p <= 1/vocab_size` 时判行等价贪心。本讲要回答的关键问题是：这里的 `vocab_size` 该用哪个宽度？
27	
28	## 3. 本讲源码地图
29	
30	| 文件 | 角色 | 本讲关注点 |
31	| --- | --- | --- |
32	| `pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs` | crate 全部实现（单文件） | `SampleScratch` 结构体定义（全部字段）、`new` / `with_selection_width` 两个构造函数、`select_batch` 顶部对 `scratch.vocab` 的校验与路由闭包里对 `selection_width` 的使用 |
33	| `pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs` | 需要 GPU 的模型无关集成测试 | `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing`——#1046 场景的回归测试，直接对比两种构造方式的行 为差异 |
34	| `pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs` | 底层核封装（crate 外，补充阅读） | `argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len` 定长公式、`BatchSamplingScratch`（非贪心侧 scratch）的字段与构造 |
35	
36	`SampleScratch` 是策略层自己拥有的状态：底层 crate `pegainfer-kernels` 提供无状态的一次性核入口（每次调用都要求调用方把缓冲传进来），本 crate 把这些缓冲**按解码路径的最大形状一次性备齐**并长期持有——这是 u1-l1 分层里「本 crate 拥有可复用 scratch」的具体形态。
37	
38	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
39	
40	### 4.1 SampleScratch::new / with_selection_width：一次分配的构造与逐字段布局
41	
42	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
43	
44	`SampleScratch` 回答一个工程问题：`select_batch` 每个解码步都要用一批中间缓冲（行号表、argmax partials、回读落地区、采样通道的整行概率缓冲……），这些缓冲该放哪？
45	
46	答案的原则写在结构体文档里：**复用 across decode steps，解码路径需要指针稳定的缓冲，所以绝不每步重分配**。两条推论：
47	
48	1. **形状在构造时烘焙**。构造时给定 `max_rows` 与 `vocab`，所有缓冲按这两个上限一次分好；之后每步实际用的行数可以更少（kernel 只处理前 k 个贪心行），但形状不能更大——超了会被 `ensure!` 拒绝（u2-l3 展开）。
49	2. **贪心与非贪心各用各的缓冲，互不相交**。贪心行走 `row_indices` → partials → `argmax_out` → pinned 落地区这条链；非贪心行走内嵌的 `BatchSamplingScratch`（它的 `probs` 缓冲要装下 `max_rows × vocab` 的 f32 概率）。两条链在 `select_batch` 里**顺序执行**（贪心分支先做完并同步，采样分支后做），没有并发写冲突，所以一份 scratch 就能服务一个贪心/采样混合批——不需要调用方为混合批准备两份状态。
50	
51	另一个容易忽略的角色：`identity_rows`，内容是恒等映射 \( 0, 1, \dots, \text{max\_rows}-1 \)。它是给「全贪心分阶段路径」（u4-l1 的 `greedy_argmax_ids`）准备的——那个路径没有「挑出的贪心行子集」可上传，但又想复用同一个 indexed argmax 核，于是干脆传一张恒等行表，让「每行都是贪心行」退化成 indexed 版本的特例。这就是本 crate 不需要第二个「连续行 argmax」核变体的原因。
52	
53	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
54	
55	构造流程（`with_selection_width` 的骨架）：
56	
57	```text
58	输入: vocab（arena 物理宽度）、selection_width（可发射宽度）、max_rows
59	1. 校验: vocab > 0 且 max_rows > 0
60	2. 校验: 0 < selection_width <= vocab
61	3. partials = argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(max_rows, vocab)   # 4.2 的公式
62	4. 分配贪心侧设备缓冲:
63	     row_indices          <- max_rows 个 i32
64	     argmax_partial_values / _indices <- partials 个
65	     top1_values          <- max_rows 个 bf16
66	     argmax_out           <- max_rows 个 i32
67	     identity_rows        <- 上传 0..max_rows 的 i32
68	5. 分配 pinned 主机落地区: argmax_host、argmax_host_alt（各 max_rows 个 i32）
69	6. sampling = BatchSamplingScratch::new(ctx, max_rows, vocab)   # 非贪心侧，注意传的是 arena 宽度
70	7. 记录 vocab、selection_width、max_rows 三个数
71	```
72	
73	之后每个解码步，`select_batch` 只**写入**这些缓冲，从不重新分配；路由判定读 `selection_width`，形状校验读 `vocab`。
74	
75	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
76	
77	先看结构体的字段定义与它自带的文档——每个字段都有一句角色说明：
78	
79	[src/lib.rs:L61-L90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L61-L90) 定义了 `SampleScratch` 的全部字段：`row_indices`（贪心行号表，indexed argmax 的输入）、两个 argmax partial 缓冲、`top1_values`、`argmax_out`、两个 pinned 落地区、`identity_rows`、内嵌 `sampling`，以及最后三个纯记录字段 `vocab` / `selection_width` / `max_rows`。结构体上方的文档注释（[src/lib.rs:L56-L60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L56-L60)）就是本节开头的两条原则：「复用 across decode steps」「贪心与非贪心行使用不相交的缓冲并顺序运行，所以单份 `SampleScratch` 覆盖完整混合批」。
80	
81	两个构造函数的关系是简单的委托：
82	
83	[src/lib.rs:L92-L95](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L92-L95) `new` 直接调 `with_selection_width(ctx, vocab, vocab, max_rows)`——默认把可发射宽度设成 arena 宽度。也就是说 `new` 只是「模型没有做 tile 对齐垫宽」时的便利入口；一旦 arena 比 词表宽，就必须显式用 `with_selection_width`。
84	
85	构造函数本体：
86	
87	[src/lib.rs:L102-L151](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L102-L151) 是 `with_selection_width` 的完整实现。关键点逐段看：
88	
89	- [src/lib.rs:L108-L115](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L108-L115) 两条前置校验：形状必须为正，且 `selection_width` 必须落在 `1..=vocab`。第二条是本讲的隐藏主线——可发射宽度不能超过物理宽度，垫宽只能让分母变大、不能让它变小。
90	- [src/lib.rs:L116](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L116) `let partials = argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(max_rows, vocab);`——partials 长度来自底层公式（4.2 节），注意传入的是 **arena 宽度**：argmax 核要扫满整行，包括填充列。
91	- [src/lib.rs:L134-L141](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L134-L141) 两个 pinned 落地区的分配，用的是 `unsafe { ctx.ctx.alloc_pinned::<i32>(max_rows) }`。字段定义处的注释（[src/lib.rs:L71-L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L71-L79)）记录了为什么必须 pinned：一次 pageable 回读的同步语义曾把亚毫秒的调用拖成 23.6ms（#704，u4-l2 专题）。`_alt` 是「上一个回读还在被收集时」的交替槽。同处的告诫：pinned 页是 write-combined 的，CPU 读不缓存，**不要把这个缓冲扩展成热点读取结构**。
92	- [src/lib.rs:L142-L145](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L142-L145) `identity_rows` 在构造时一次性上传 `0..max_rows`——它是常量表，之后每步都复用。
93	- [src/lib.rs:L146](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L146) `sampling: BatchSamplingScratch::new(ctx, max_rows, vocab)?`——非贪心侧 scratch 在这里嵌进来，注意第三个参数传的是 **arena 宽度** `vocab` 而不是 `selection_width`：采样器读整行 logits，概率缓冲按物理宽度备。
94	
95	「一次分配」在消费端的样子——`select_batch` 的贪心分支只写不配：
96	
97	[src/lib.rs:L234-L237](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L234-L237) 每步把贪心行号 `memcpy_htod` **写进已有的** `scratch.row_indices`（长度永远是 `max_rows`，本步只前 `greedy.len()` 个有效）；[src/lib.rs:L238-L247](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L238-L247) 把 scratch 的六个缓冲按引用喂给 `argmax_batch_bf16_split_indexed_into`；[src/lib.rs:L248-L262](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L248-L262) D2H 写进 pinned 槽 `argmax_host`、自旋等拷贝事件、再按行号把 token 归位。整条链没有任何 `alloc`。
98	
99	`identity_rows` 的实际消费者在分阶段路径：
100	
101	[src/lib.rs:L344-L368](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L344-L368) `greedy_argmax_ids` 用 `&scratch.identity_rows` 当行号表调用**同一个** indexed argmax 核——「处理第 0..rows 行」被表达成「处理行号表为恒等映射的前 rows 项」。贪心路由路径（上一段）上传的是本步动态挑出的贪心行子集，分阶段路径上传的是静态恒等表；同一个核、同一份 partials 与输出缓冲，两种用法通吃。
102	
103	补充阅读——非贪心侧 `BatchSamplingScratch` 长什么样（本 crate 视角它是个黑盒，但字段值得认识）：
104	
105	[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L32-L77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L32-L77)（crate 外，永久链接指向同一 commit 的 kernels 路径）定义并构造了它：大头是 `probs: CudaSlice<f32>`，长度 `max_rows * vocab`——一行全宽概率的 f32 展开，是整份 scratch 里最大的显存消费者；其余是每行参数（`temperature` / `top_k` / `top_p` / `min_p`）的小缓冲、`out`、以及 OnlineSoftmax 词表切分用的 workspace（字节数 `max_rows * ⌈vocab/8192⌉ * 8 + 256`）。它同样只在构造时分配一次。
106	
107	#### 4.1.4 代码实践
108	
109	**实践目标**：把「一次分配」从口号变成一张可核对的账目表——给定 `vocab = 151936`、`max_rows = 16`，逐项写出 `SampleScratch` 每个缓冲的元素类型、长度与用途。这是纯纸面推导，不需要 GPU。
110	
111	**操作步骤**：
112	
113	1. 打开 [src/lib.rs:L61-L90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L61-L90)，对每个字段问三个问题：元素类型是什么？长度由哪个公式给出（`max_rows`、`max_rows × vocab`、还是 `partials`）？谁在什么时候写它、谁读它？
114	2. `partials` 一项代入 [src/lib.rs:L116](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L116) 的公式手算：\( \lceil 151936 / 4096 \rceil = \lceil 37.093\ldots \rceil = 38 \)（验算：\( 4096 \times 37 = 151552 \)，余 384，所以要第 38 个 tile），再乘 `max_rows = 16`。
115	3. 顺手估算显存量级：贪心侧全部缓冲加起来多大？`sampling.probs` 一项又是多大？（f32 按 4 字节、bf16 按 2 字节、i32 按 4 字节。）
116	4. 如需机械验证，可以把长度公式抄进一个临时脚本（示例代码，不属于项目）：
117	
118	   ```rust
119	   // 示例代码：仅用于核对长度公式，不依赖项目与 GPU
120	   fn main() {
121	       let (vocab, max_rows): (usize, usize) = (151_936, 16);
122	       let partials = max_rows * vocab.div_ceil(4096);
123	       println!("partials = {partials}");                       // 期望 608
124	       println!("probs(f32) = {}", max_rows * vocab);            // 期望 2_430_976
125	       println!("softmax_ws = {}", max_rows * vocab.div_ceil(8192) * 8 + 256); // 期望 2688
126	   }
127	   ```

129	**需要观察的现象 / 预期结果**（参考答案）：
130	
131	| 缓冲 | 位置 | 元素类型 | 长度（vocab=151936, max_rows=16） | 用途 |
132	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
133	| `row_indices` | 设备 | `i32` | 16 | 贪心行号表；每步 H2D 重写前 k 项，indexed argmax 的输入 |
134	| `argmax_partial_values` | 设备 | `f32` | 608 | 两阶段 argmax 第一阶段：每个 tile 的局部最大值 |
135	| `argmax_partial_indices` | 设备 | `i32` | 608 | 每个 tile 局部最大值的全局下标（partials 携带全局下标才能保破并列次序） |
136	| `top1_values` | 设备 | `bf16` | 16 | 每贪心行 top-1 logit——argmax 核的必要出参，本 crate 不读它 |
137	| `argmax_out` | 设备 | `i32` | 16 | 每贪心行一个 token id，按 `row_indices` 顺序 |
138	| `argmax_host` | 主机（pinned） | `i32` | 16 | `argmax_out` 的固定页落地区（回读槽 0） |

170	### 4.2 argmax partials 定长公式：\( R \times \lceil V / 4096 \rceil \)
171	
172	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
173	
174	partials 缓冲的长度不是拍脑袋的常数，而是由 argmax 核的并行结构**推导**出来的定值。理解这个公式等于理解「split argmax 为什么存在」：
175	
176	- 单 CTA 扫一行 15 万元素，并行度太低、延迟太高；
177	- 把每行切成 4096 元素一段的 tile，\( \lceil V/4096 \rceil \) 个 CTA 各自求出局部 (max, 全局下标)——每个 CTA 产出一对，这正是 partial 缓冲要装的东西；
178	- 每行再由一个 CTA 归约本行的所有 partial，得到最终 argmax。
179	
180	于是对 `max_rows` 行的批，第一阶段最多同时产出 \( R \times \lceil V/4096 \rceil \) 对 partial——缓冲长度就定死为这个数。它是**上界也是精确值**：核的校验代码要求 partial 缓冲**至少**这么长（长了浪费、短了直接报错拒绝）。
181	
182	一个值得注意的对偶：partials 里存的是 (f32 值, i32 全局下标)。用 f32 存局部最大值而不是 bf16，是因为归约阶段要做跨 tile 比较，加宽可以避免归约自身引入额外舍入；而「全局下标」保证了破并列次序与单块扫描**位级一致**（最低全局下标胜出）——这与 u2-l1 讲的「argmax 按最低下标破 bf16 并列」一脉相承。
183	
184	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
185	
186	\[ \text{partials}(R, V) = R \times \left\lceil \frac{V}{4096} \right\rceil \]
187

192	| 1 | 8 | 1 | 8 |
193	| 1 | 151,936 | 38 | 38 |
194	| 16 | 151,936 | 38 | 608 |
195	| 17 | 151,936 | 38 | 646 |

243	### 4.3 selection_width 与 tile 对齐词表：#1046 的教训
244	
245	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
246	
247	u2-l1 建立了核坍缩判据：\( \text{top\_p} \le 1/V \) 时核只剩 argmax 一个 token，该行等价贪心、必须走确定性的 argmax 路径。这个 \( V \) 是**可发射 token 的个数**。
248	
249	麻烦在于：模型可能为了让 logits GEMM 跑在 tile 倍数宽度上，把 arena 从 \( V \)（真实词表）垫宽到 \( W > V \)。填充列不是可发射 token，但它们物理上躺在 arena 里，`logits.hidden_dim` 读出来是 \( W \)。如果路由判定错用了 \( W \)：
250	
251	\[ \frac{1}{W} < \frac{1}{V} \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \exists\, \text{top\_p}:\ \frac{1}{W} < \text{top\_p} \le \frac{1}{V} \]
252	
253	也就是存在一族 `top_p` 取值——在真实词表上本应坍缩成单 token 核、走 argmax——却因为分母被填充列撑大而不满足判据，被错路由到拒绝采样器。后果正是 u2-l1 分析过的：遇到 bf16 并列最大值时，采样器会随种子随机挑一个并列者，**一个本应确定的请求变成了随机的**。这就是 qwen35 tile 对齐引发 #1046 的机制。
254	
255	修复是把两个宽度显式分开：
256	
257	- `vocab`（= arena 物理宽度 \( W \)）：管**形状**——所有缓冲按它分配，argmax 核扫满整行，`select_batch` 校验 arena 宽度与它一致；
258	- `selection_width`（= 可发射宽度 \( V \)）：只管**路由**——`effectively_greedy` 的分母用它。
259	
260	测试 `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing` 的注释（[tests/select_batch.rs:L182-L184](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L182-L184)）把这个场景总结成一句话：在未垫宽的 arena 上坍缩为 argmax 的 top_p，垫宽一倍后必须**仍然**坍缩。

306	
307	对照组的巧妙之处值得多说一句：它不是「多余的负面测试」，而是先**证明 bug 现象真实存在**（宽度用错时行为确实变了），再证明修复有效。没有对照组，即使修复组通过，也无法排除「这个 top_p 本来就不会采到并列者」的侥幸解释。

309	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
310	
311	**实践目标**：通过一个「故意用错构造函数」的思想实验，确认你理解了 `selection_width` 唯一的职责是路由分母。
312	
313	**操作步骤**：
314	
315	1. 通读 [tests/select_batch.rs:L180-L219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L180-L219)，标出：`decodable`、`vocab`、`lo`、`hi`、`tiny` 各是什么，对照组与修复组**唯一的差别**是哪一个构造调用。

321	> 失败的是修复组循环内的 `assert_eq!(select_batch(...), vec![lo], "seed {s}: the decodable vocab must keep this row on the argmax path")`（tests/select_batch.rs:213-217）。原因：`new` 把 `selection_width` 设成 512，`is_argmax` 里 `top_p = 1/256 <= 1/512` 不再成立，`effectively_greedy` 判负，该行被路由到拒绝采样器；而 `lo` 与 `hi` 是两个 bf16 完全相同的 8.0 峰，采样器随种子二选一，64 个种子里几乎必然出现一次 `hi`（=200），与断言的 `lo`（=128）相撞。这正是对照组已演示过的行为——改回去之后，修复组退化成了对照组。

349

361	3. **语义检查**：模型乙如果错用模型甲的构造方式（`new(ctx, 155648, 16)`），会先在哪一步被拒绝？（答案：**不会**被拒绝——`new` 完全合法，`selection_width` 静默变成 155648；错误只在运行时表现为：`top_p` 落在 \( (1/155648,\, 1/151936] \) 区间的请求被错路由到采样器，在 bf16 并列最大值上随机化。这是一个**不报错的语义 bug**，正是 #1046 的形态，也是为什么回归测试要存在。）

383	## 6. 本讲小结
384	
385	- `SampleScratch` 是**一次分配、长期持有**的解码路径缓冲集合：解码路径要求指针稳定（CUDA 图烘焙地址、每步零分配），所以形状在构造时按 `(max_rows, vocab)` 烘焙，之后只写不配。
386	- 逐字段分工：贪心链是 `row_indices`（行号表）→ `argmax_partial_values/_indices`（两阶段 argmax 的 tile 局部结果）→ `top1_values`（核的必要出参，本 crate 不读）→ `argmax_out` → 两个 **pinned** 交替落地区；`identity_rows` 是常量恒等表，让全贪心分阶段路径复用同一个 indexed argmax 核；非贪心链整体住进内嵌的 `BatchSamplingScratch`。
387	- partials 长度是推导出来的定值：\( R \times \lceil V/4096 \rceil \)，随行数线性、随词表宽度阶梯式增长；kernels 侧在每次 launch 前重算复核，策略层用 `scratch.vocab` 保证 arena 宽度一致。
388	- `vocab`（arena 物理宽度）与 `selection_width`（可发射宽度）必须分开：前者管所有形状与缓冲，后者只当 `effectively_greedy` 的分母。tile 垫宽列不可发射，若撑大分母会把本应坍缩为 argmax 的 `top_p` 行错推进拒绝采样器，在 bf16 并列最大值上随机化（#1046，回归测试 `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing`）。
389	- 贪心与非贪心缓冲天然不相交且两分支顺序执行，所以**一份** scratch 就能服务贪心/采样混合批；显存大头是非贪心侧的 `probs`（`max_rows × vocab` 的 f32），贪心侧全套只有几 KB。

394	
395	延伸阅读：
396	
397	- `pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs` 中 `argmax_bf16_split_into` / `argmax_batch_bf16_split_indexed_into` 的实现与注释——partials 校验、破并列次序的位级一致性保证。

# SampleScratch：一次分配的缓冲区布局与 selection_width

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

- 逐字段说出 `SampleScratch` 里每个缓冲区的角色：`row_indices`、`argmax_partial_values` / `argmax_partial_indices`、`top1_values`、`argmax_out`、`argmax_host` / `argmax_host_alt`、`identity_rows`，以及内嵌的 `BatchSamplingScratch`。
- 解释解码路径为什么要求**一次分配、指针稳定**——绝不能每个解码步重新分配设备缓冲。
- 用定长公式 \( R \times \lceil V / 4096 \rceil \) 算出 argmax partials 缓冲的元素个数，并说明它来自两阶段（split）argmax 的 tiling 结构。
- 说清 `vocab`（arena 物理宽度）与 `selection_width`（可发射词表宽度）为什么是两个数：模型把 logits GEMM 对齐到 tile 倍数后，多出来的填充列不是可发射 token，不能参与 u2-l1 讲的 `top_p <= 1/宽度` 核坍缩判定（#1046 场景）。
- 论证贪心行与非贪心行的缓冲为什么互不相交、可以共用同一份 scratch 服务一个混合批。

本讲是单元二的第二讲：u2-l1 已经确定了「一行走不走 argmax」的判定条件，本讲看这个判定的**物质基础**——判定所依赖的 `selection_width`、判定结果所写入的全部缓冲，都住在这份一次分配的 `SampleScratch` 里。下一讲 u2-l3 会沿着这些缓冲走通 `select_batch` 的三路分发。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲需要一点 GPU 内存模型的常识，全部概念先用直觉语言讲一遍。

- **解码步（decode step）**：自回归生成是循环的——每一步模型为批内每个活跃请求算出一行 logits（全词表各一个分数），采样层从每行选出一个 token id，再把 token 喂回模型。采样层因此被调用成千上万次，每次的输入输出形状几乎完全一样。
- **设备内存与主机内存**：GPU 自己的显存（device memory）与 CPU 内存（host memory）是两块独立空间，靠 H2D（host-to-device，上行）与 D2H（device-to-host，下行）拷贝交换数据。`CudaSlice<T>` 是一块显存的 Rust 句柄。
- **分配很贵，拷贝也不免费**：`cudaMalloc` 量级的显存分配是慢操作（可能牵动驱动同步），H2D / D2H 拷贝则要走 PCIe。推理引擎的常规做法是**启动时按最大形状分配一次，之后每步只写入数据、不重新分配**。
- **指针稳定（pointer stability）**：CUDA 图（CUDA Graph）会把一整段核调用录制下来重放，录制时烘焙的是**缓冲的地址**。如果某一步换了缓冲（重新分配），地址变了，图里录的旧地址就指向已释放或错误的内存。所以「解码路径的缓冲绝不能每步重分配」不是性能建议，是正确性约束（u4-l1 展开）。
- **pinned 内存（页锁定内存）**：普通主机内存是可换页的，从它做 D2H 拷贝时驱动会先把它钉住再拷，语义偏同步；用 `alloc_pinned` 预先锁定的页则支持真正的异步 D2H。本讲只需要记住：`SampleScratch` 的两个主机落地区是 pinned 的，事故级的细节（#704）留给 u4-l2。
- **两阶段（split / tiled）argmax 的直觉**：一行 15 万个 bf16 的 argmax 如果只用一个 GPU 线程块（CTA）扫，太慢。把一行切成若干 4096 元素的 tile，每个 tile 由一个 CTA 求出局部的 (最大值, 下标)——这就是 **partial**；第二阶段每行用一个 CTA 把所有 partial 归约成全局 argmax。partial 的个数决定了缓冲长度。
- **tile 对齐与填充列**：GEMM（矩阵乘）在 tile 倍数宽度上效率最高，模型可能把 logits 输出宽度从真实词表 \( V \)（如 151936）垫宽到 tile 的倍数。垫出来的列**不是可发射 token**——采样决策不能把它们数进词表宽度。
- **承接 u2-l1**：`effectively_greedy(params, vocab_size)` 在 `top_p <= 1/vocab_size` 时判行等价贪心。本讲要回答的关键问题是：这里的 `vocab_size` 该用哪个宽度？

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 | 本讲关注点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs` | crate 全部实现（单文件） | `SampleScratch` 结构体定义（全部字段）、`new` / `with_selection_width` 两个构造函数、`select_batch` 顶部对 `scratch.vocab` 的校验与路由闭包里对 `selection_width` 的使用 |
| `pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs` | 需要 GPU 的模型无关集成测试 | `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing`——#1046 场景的回归测试，直接对比两种构造方式的行 为差异 |
| `pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs` | 底层核封装（crate 外，补充阅读） | `argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len` 定长公式、`BatchSamplingScratch`（非贪心侧 scratch）的字段与构造 |

`SampleScratch` 是策略层自己拥有的状态：底层 crate `pegainfer-kernels` 提供无状态的一次性核入口（每次调用都要求调用方把缓冲传进来），本 crate 把这些缓冲**按解码路径的最大形状一次性备齐**并长期持有——这是 u1-l1 分层里「本 crate 拥有可复用 scratch」的具体形态。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 SampleScratch::new / with_selection_width：一次分配的构造与逐字段布局

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`SampleScratch` 回答一个工程问题：`select_batch` 每个解码步都要用一批中间缓冲（行号表、argmax partials、回读落地区、采样通道的整行概率缓冲……），这些缓冲该放哪？

答案的原则写在结构体文档里：**复用 across decode steps，解码路径需要指针稳定的缓冲，所以绝不每步重分配**。两条推论：

1. **形状在构造时烘焙**。构造时给定 `max_rows` 与 `vocab`，所有缓冲按这两个上限一次分好；之后每步实际用的行数可以更少（kernel 只处理前 k 个贪心行），但形状不能更大——超了会被 `ensure!` 拒绝（u2-l3 展开）。
2. **贪心与非贪心各用各的缓冲，互不相交**。贪心行走 `row_indices` → partials → `argmax_out` → pinned 落地区这条链；非贪心行走内嵌的 `BatchSamplingScratch`（它的 `probs` 缓冲要装下 `max_rows × vocab` 的 f32 概率）。两条链在 `select_batch` 里**顺序执行**（贪心分支先做完并同步，采样分支后做），没有并发写冲突，所以一份 scratch 就能服务一个贪心/采样混合批——不需要调用方为混合批准备两份状态。

另一个容易忽略的角色：`identity_rows`，内容是恒等映射 \( 0, 1, \dots, \text{max\_rows}-1 \)。它是给「全贪心分阶段路径」（u4-l1 的 `greedy_argmax_ids`）准备的——那个路径没有「挑出的贪心行子集」可上传，但又想复用同一个 indexed argmax 核，于是干脆传一张恒等行表，让「每行都是贪心行」退化成 indexed 版本的特例。这就是本 crate 不需要第二个「连续行 argmax」核变体的原因。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

构造流程（`with_selection_width` 的骨架）：

```text
输入: vocab（arena 物理宽度）、selection_width（可发射宽度）、max_rows
1. 校验: vocab > 0 且 max_rows > 0
2. 校验: 0 < selection_width <= vocab
3. partials = argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(max_rows, vocab)   # 4.2 的公式
4. 分配贪心侧设备缓冲:
     row_indices          <- max_rows 个 i32
     argmax_partial_values / _indices <- partials 个
     top1_values          <- max_rows 个 bf16
     argmax_out           <- max_rows 个 i32
     identity_rows        <- 上传 0..max_rows 的 i32
5. 分配 pinned 主机落地区: argmax_host、argmax_host_alt（各 max_rows 个 i32）
6. sampling = BatchSamplingScratch::new(ctx, max_rows, vocab)   # 非贪心侧，注意传的是 arena 宽度
7. 记录 vocab、selection_width、max_rows 三个数
```

之后每个解码步，`select_batch` 只**写入**这些缓冲，从不重新分配；路由判定读 `selection_width`，形状校验读 `vocab`。

### 4.2 argmax partials 定长公式：\( R \times \lceil V / 4096 \rceil \)

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

partials 缓冲的长度不是拍脑袋的常数，而是由 argmax 核的并行结构**推导**出来的定值。理解这个公式等于理解「split argmax 为什么存在」：

- 单 CTA 扫一行 15 万元素，并行度太低、延迟太高；
- 把每行切成 4096 元素一段的 tile，\( \lceil V/4096 \rceil \) 个 CTA 各自求出局部 (max, 全局下标)——每个 CTA 产出一对，这正是 partial 缓冲要装的东西；
- 每行再由一个 CTA 归约本行的所有 partial，得到最终 argmax。

于是对 `max_rows` 行的批，第一阶段最多同时产出 \( R \times \lceil V/4096 \rceil \) 对 partial——缓冲长度就定死为这个数。它是**上界也是精确值**：核的校验代码要求 partial 缓冲**至少**这么长（长了浪费、短了直接报错拒绝）。

一个值得注意的对偶：partials 里存的是 (f32 值, i32 全局下标)。用 f32 存局部最大值而不是 bf16，是因为归约阶段要做跨 tile 比较，加宽可以避免归约自身引入额外舍入；而「全局下标」保证了破并列次序与单块扫描**位级一致**（最低全局下标胜出）——这与 u2-l1 讲的「argmax 按最低下标破 bf16 并列」一脉相承。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

\[ \text{partials}(R, V) = R \times \left\lceil \frac{V}{4096} \right\rceil \]

代入几个真实形状：

| R（行） | V（词表宽度） | \( \lceil V/4096 \rceil \) | partials 元素数 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 8 | 1 | 8 |
| 1 | 151,936 | 38 | 38 |
| 16 | 151,936 | 38 | 608 |
| 17 | 151,936 | 38 | 646 |

第三行是 4.1 表里那份数；第四行正是延迟探针测试（`select_batch_span17_latency_probe`，span-17）构造 scratch 时的形状。注意 partials 随行数**线性**增长、随词表宽度**阶梯式**增长（每跨过一个 4096 倍数加一档）。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

公式本体住在 kernels crate（本 crate 通过 [src/lib.rs:L43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L43) 引入它）：

[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L368-L371](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L368-L371) `argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(rows, vocab) = rows * vocab.div_ceil(4096)`，`TILE_ELEMS = 4096` 就写在这一行旁边。紧挨着的 [pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L373-L382](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L373-L382) 是一个很好的对照组：Markov-step argmax 的 tile 是 **1024** 元素（它的每行读取量小，需要 4 倍的块数才不致延迟受限），所以它有自己的 `markov_step_argmax_partials_len`——同一思想、不同 tile 常数、各自一个定长公式。

### 4.3 selection_width 与 tile 对齐词表：#1046 的教训

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

u2-l1 建立了核坍缩判据：\( \text{top\_p} \le 1/V \) 时核只剩 argmax 一个 token，该行等价贪心、必须走确定性的 argmax 路径。这个 \( V \) 是**可发射 token 的个数**。

麻烦在于：模型可能为了让 logits GEMM 跑在 tile 倍数宽度上，把 arena 从 \( V \)（真实词表）垫宽到 \( W > V \)。填充列不是可发射 token，但它们物理上躺在 arena 里，`logits.hidden_dim` 读出来是 \( W \)。如果路由判定错用了 \( W \)：

\[ \frac{1}{W} < \frac{1}{V} \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \exists\, \text{top\_p}:\ \frac{1}{W} < \text{top\_p} \le \frac{1}{V} \]

也就是存在一族 `top_p` 取值——在真实词表上本应坍缩成单 token 核、走 argmax——却因为分母被填充列撑大而不满足判据，被错路由到拒绝采样器。后果正是 u2-l1 分析过的：遇到 bf16 并列最大值时，采样器会随种子随机挑一个并列者，**一个本应确定的请求变成了随机的**。这就是 qwen35 tile 对齐引发 #1046 的机制。

修复是把两个宽度显式分开：

- `vocab`（= arena 物理宽度 \( W \)）：管**形状**——所有缓冲按它分配，argmax 核扫满整行，`select_batch` 校验 arena 宽度与它一致；
- `selection_width`（= 可发射宽度 \( V \)）：只管**路由**——`effectively_greedy` 的分母用它。

测试 `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing` 的注释（[tests/select_batch.rs:L182-L184](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L182-L184)）把这个场景总结成一句话：在未垫宽的 arena 上坍缩为 argmax 的 top_p，垫宽一倍后必须**仍然**坍缩。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

一次 `select_batch` 调用中两个宽度的分工：

```text
arena (物理宽度 W = logits.hidden_dim, 含 tile 填充列)
  │
  ├─ 形状校验:  W == scratch.vocab            # 不相等立即报错
  ├─ argmax 核: 扫满 W 列                      # partials、核校验都用 W
  ├─ 采样器:    读满 W 列的整行               # BatchSamplingScratch 按 W 分配
  │
  └─ 路由判定:  effectively_greedy(p, scratch.selection_width)   # 只用 V
                  └─ top_p <= 1/V ?  → argmax 路径（确定性破并列）
                                    否   → 采样路径
```

构造侧的对应选择：

```text
模型未垫宽 (W == V):        SampleScratch::new(ctx, V, max_rows)          # 默认 selection_width = vocab
模型垫宽   (W >  V):        SampleScratch::with_selection_width(ctx, W, V, max_rows)
                            # 第 2 参数管形状，第 3 参数管路由
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

构造函数的文档注释把动机写得非常直白：

[src/lib.rs:L97-L101](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L97-L101) 「For an arena spanning `vocab` columns whose last `vocab - selection_width` columns the model cannot emit」——arena 有 `vocab` 列，但末尾 `vocab - selection_width` 列不可发射（模型为了凑 GEMM tile 倍数垫的宽）。这些填充列**不得**撑大 `top_p <= 1/vocab` 核判定的分母，否则本应等价贪心的请求会跌进拒绝采样器、在 bf16 并列最大值上随机化。配套校验 [src/lib.rs:L112-L115](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L112-L115) 把合法域定死为 `selection_width ∈ 1..=vocab`。
